title: 雙護盾硬岩潛盾施工
summary: 雙護盾可讓切削與管片組裝在不同機構上進行，但並行能力依賴岩壁提供可靠反力、伸縮行程和後勤同步。本課由接觸承壓、軸向推力、循環時間進到擠壓岩與偏轉判讀，將設備能力、地層限制及觀測證據分開列帳。所有數字為教學假設，結論是辨識需要停點審查的條件，不是掘進機操作參數。
summaryEn: A double shield can separate excavation from segment assembly, but concurrent work depends on a reliable rock reaction, available telescopic travel and synchronized logistics. This course follows contact stress, axial thrust and cycle time into squeezing-ground and steering interpretations. Machine capability, ground limitations and observed evidence are recorded separately. All numerical inputs are teaching assumptions; the outcome identifies conditions requiring engineering review rather than machine operating parameters.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下原創算例針對雙護盾伸縮機構、兩種反力路徑與施工循環的可靠度，每個輸入都是教學假設而非地標實測資料。教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設名義行程1.8 m、保留餘量0.3 m，可用行程1.8-0.3=1.5 m；以1.2 m一環計算，只能完整涵蓋floor(1.5/1.2)=1環。教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設法向合力8 MN、有效面積4 m²，平均壓力8/4=2 MPa；若有效接觸只剩2 m²，平均壓力變成4 MPa，均非容許值。兩式只回答各自所列的量與邊界，不應把單一平均結果當成整體穩定證明。請另以最不利的幾何、時間或接觸條件代入，分別標示量測誤差和模型偏差；交接記錄須保留原單位、資料日期以及未能確認的條件。
workedExample.textEn: This original worked example examines double-shield telescoping, dual reaction paths and construction-cycle reliability. Every input is a teaching assumption, not a measured value from a landmark. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume nominal travel 1.8 m and reserved travel 0.3 m. Usable travel is 1.8-0.3=1.5 m, covering floor(1.5/1.2)=1 complete ring of width 1.2 m. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume normal force 8 MN over effective area 4 m²: mean pressure is 8/4=2 MPa. Reducing effective contact to 2 m² raises it to 4 MPa. Neither is an allowable value. Each relation answers only its stated quantity under its stated boundary conditions. A favorable mean value is not proof of overall stability. Recalculate with an adverse geometry, timing or contact condition, distinguishing measurement uncertainty from model error. The handover record must retain original units, observation dates and conditions that remain unverified; the responsible designer decides whether additional evidence is needed.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「伸縮行程與循環約束」與「撐靴接觸與局部岩壁」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Telescopic travel and cycle constraint" and "Gripper contact and local rock wall": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 伸縮行程與循環約束：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Telescopic travel and cycle constraint: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「伸縮行程與循環約束」如何影響雙護盾硬岩潛盾施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Telescopic travel and cycle constraint” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Double-shield hard-rock TBM operation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 前盾前移而後盾暫時定位，伸縮接頭讓切削行程與後方作業分離；可用行程仍受幾何餘量與端點限制，不能把名義最大伸長全部用作生產距離。 假設名義行程1.8 m、保留餘量0.3 m，可用行程1.8-0.3=1.5 m；以1.2 m一環計算，只能完整涵蓋floor(1.5/1.2)=1環。 行程訊號漂移會讓顯示餘量大於真實間隙，端點接近時推力突升且循環停頓；若只將停頓歸為岩性變硬，接頭與反力路徑的異常便可能漏判。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「伸縮行程與循環約束」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The front shield moves while the rear shield remains temporarily located. Telescoping separates cutting travel from work behind it, but usable travel still depends on geometric reserve and end limits. Nominal maximum extension is not entirely available for production. Assume nominal travel 1.8 m and reserved travel 0.3 m. Usable travel is 1.8-0.3=1.5 m, covering floor(1.5/1.2)=1 complete ring of width 1.2 m. A drifting travel signal can overstate remaining clearance. Near an end limit, thrust may rise while advance stops. Attributing this solely to stronger rock can conceal a telescopic joint or reaction-path problem. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Telescopic travel and cycle constraint” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「伸縮行程夠長便能無限並行掘進與拼裝。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Long telescopic travel allows excavation and assembly to continue concurrently without interruption." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「伸縮行程與循環約束」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Telescopic travel and cycle constraint”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 伸縮行程與循環約束
knowledge.text: 前盾前移而後盾暫時定位，伸縮接頭讓切削行程與後方作業分離；可用行程仍受幾何餘量與端點限制，不能把名義最大伸長全部用作生產距離。假設名義行程1.8 m、保留餘量0.3 m，可用行程1.8-0.3=1.5 m；以1.2 m一環計算，只能完整涵蓋floor(1.5/1.2)=1環。
knowledge.textEn: The front shield moves while the rear shield remains temporarily located. Telescoping separates cutting travel from work behind it, but usable travel still depends on geometric reserve and end limits.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：伸縮行程夠長便能無限並行掘進與拼裝。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Long telescopic travel allows excavation and assembly to continue concurrently without interruption. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「伸縮行程與循環約束」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Telescopic travel and cycle constraint" is correct?
options: 伸縮行程夠長便能無限並行掘進與拼裝。
前盾前移而後盾暫時定位，伸縮接頭讓切削行程與後方作業分離；可用行程仍受幾何餘量與端點限制，不能把名義最大伸長全部用作生產距離。
完整岩芯強度很高便保證撐靴不會滑移。
optionsEn: Long telescopic travel allows excavation and assembly to continue concurrently without interruption.
The front shield moves while the rear shield remains temporarily located.
High intact-core strength guarantees that grippers cannot slip against the tunnel wall.
quiz.explanation: 前盾前移而後盾暫時定位，伸縮接頭讓切削行程與後方作業分離；可用行程仍受幾何餘量與端點限制，不能把名義最大伸長全部用作生產距離。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The front shield moves while the rear shield remains temporarily located. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 伸縮行程與循環約束：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Telescopic travel and cycle constraint: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「伸縮行程與循環約束」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Telescopic travel and cycle constraint” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設名義行程1.8 m、保留餘量0.3 m，可用行程1.8-0.3=1.5 m；以1.2 m一環計算，只能完整涵蓋floor(1.5/1.2)=1環。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume nominal travel 1.8 m and reserved travel 0.3 m. Usable travel is 1.8-0.3=1.5 m, covering floor(1.5/1.2)=1 complete ring of width 1.2 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以校正過的行程計和獨立幾何尺量核對前後盾相對位置，將各環起訖與重新定位時間畫在同一時軸；若端點餘量不符設計假設，必須先檢討循環安排，不以增加推力掩蓋行程不足。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare calibrated travel transducers with an independent geometric measurement of relative shield position.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設名義行程1.8 m、保留餘量0.3 m，可用行程1.8-0.3=1.5 m；以1.2 m一環計算，只能完整涵蓋floor(1.5/1.2)=1環。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume nominal travel 1.8 m and reserved travel 0.3 m. Usable travel is 1.8-0.3=1.5 m, covering floor(1.5/1.2)=1 complete ring of width 1.2 m.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「伸縮行程與循環約束」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Telescopic travel and cycle constraint", which statement holds?
options: 只要總推力相同，岩壁與管片反力模式等效。
停機沒有切削，岩體與盾殼接觸狀態便不變。
教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: Rock reaction and segment reaction are equivalent whenever total thrust is unchanged.
Without cutting during a shutdown, ground contact with the shield remains unchanged.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 伸縮行程與循環約束：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Telescopic travel and cycle constraint: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「伸縮行程與循環約束」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Telescopic travel and cycle constraint” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以校正過的行程計和獨立幾何尺量核對前後盾相對位置，將各環起訖與重新定位時間畫在同一時軸；若端點餘量不符設計假設，必須先檢討循環安排，不以增加推力掩蓋行程不足。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare calibrated travel transducers with an independent geometric measurement of relative shield position. Plot ring boundaries and regripping on a shared clock. If end reserve differs from the design assumption, review the cycle before treating additional thrust as a remedy for insufficient travel. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每一班以共同環號保存行程零點、餘量和定位事件；機械工程師確認傳感器與端點保護，施工主管確認循環可行後才接受新的時間預算。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Keep travel zero, reserve and positioning events under the same ring identifier each shift. The mechanical engineer verifies instrumentation and end protection; the construction lead confirms cycle feasibility before accepting a revised time budget.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：行程訊號漂移會讓顯示餘量大於真實間隙，端點接近時推力突升且循環停頓；若只將停頓歸為岩性變硬，接頭與反力路徑的異常便可能漏判。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A drifting travel signal can overstate remaining clearance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 以校正過的行程計和獨立幾何尺量核對前後盾相對位置，將各環起訖與重新定位時間畫在同一時軸；若端點餘量不符設計假設，必須先檢討循環安排，不以增加推力掩蓋行程不足。
knowledge.textEn: Compare calibrated travel transducers with an independent geometric measurement of relative shield position. Plot ring boundaries and regripping on a shared clock. If end reserve differs from the design assumption, review the cycle before treating additional thrust as a remedy for insufficient travel.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 每一班以共同環號保存行程零點、餘量和定位事件；機械工程師確認傳感器與端點保護，施工主管確認循環可行後才接受新的時間預算。
knowledge.textEn: Keep travel zero, reserve and positioning events under the same ring identifier each shift. The mechanical engineer verifies instrumentation and end protection; the construction lead confirms cycle feasibility before accepting a revised time budget.

quiz.question: 要驗證「伸縮行程與循環約束」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Telescopic travel and cycle constraint"?
options: 以校正過的行程計和獨立幾何尺量核對前後盾相對位置，將各環起訖與重新定位時間畫在同一時軸；若端點餘量不符設計假設，必須先檢討循環安排，不以增加推力掩蓋行程不足。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
單位體積能耗上升便能唯一反算岩石強度。
optionsEn: Compare calibrated travel transducers with an independent geometric measurement of relative shield position.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
An increase in energy per excavated volume uniquely determines higher rock strength.
quiz.explanation: 以校正過的行程計和獨立幾何尺量核對前後盾相對位置，將各環起訖與重新定位時間畫在同一時軸；若端點餘量不符設計假設，必須先檢討循環安排，不以增加推力掩蓋行程不足。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare calibrated travel transducers with an independent geometric measurement of relative shield position. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 伸縮行程與循環約束：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Telescopic travel and cycle constraint: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「伸縮行程與循環約束」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Telescopic travel and cycle constraint” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 行程訊號漂移會讓顯示餘量大於真實間隙，端點接近時推力突升且循環停頓；若只將停頓歸為岩性變硬，接頭與反力路徑的異常便可能漏判。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A drifting travel signal can overstate remaining clearance. Near an end limit, thrust may rise while advance stops. Attributing this solely to stronger rock can conceal a telescopic joint or reaction-path problem. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：行程訊號漂移會讓顯示餘量大於真實間隙，端點接近時推力突升且循環停頓；若只將停頓歸為岩性變硬，接頭與反力路徑的異常便可能漏判。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Attributing this solely to stronger rock can conceal a telescopic joint or reaction-path problem.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「伸縮行程夠長便能無限並行掘進與拼裝。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Long telescopic travel allows excavation and assembly to continue concurrently without interruption." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

knowledge.title: 失效模式

steps.instruction: 撐靴把推進反力傳入有限的岩壁接觸區，平均接觸壓力與局部節理幾何共同影響反力可靠度。總力相同時，真實接觸面積變小會放大局部壓力，完整試體強度不能直接代表破碎岩壁。 假設法向合力8 MN、有效面積4 m²，平均壓力8/4=2 MPa；若有效接觸只剩2 m²，平均壓力變成4 MPa，均非容許值。 沿節理剝落會縮小接觸區，顯示壓力可能仍正常但機體持續滑移；若把提高法向力當成通用解答，岩壁破壞可能擴大並干擾推進控制。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「撐靴接觸與局部岩壁」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Assume normal force 8 MN over effective area 4 m²: mean pressure is 8/4=2 MPa. Reducing effective contact to 2 m² raises it to 4 MPa. Neither is an allowable value. Spalling along joints reduces the effective contact. Displayed pressure may look normal while the machine slips. Increasing normal force as a universal remedy may enlarge wall damage and further disturb thrust control. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Gripper contact and local rock wall” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objective: 說明「襯砌反力與局部承壓」如何影響雙護盾硬岩潛盾施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。

steps.instruction: 當岩壁反力不足而改由已完成管片承受推力時，力流轉向推靴接觸、管片接縫及環間傳遞。平均分配僅供列帳，實際偏心和缺口會造成個別推靴較大的局部承壓。 假設總推力12 MN由24個推靴平均承擔，各為0.5 MN；每個有效面積0.1 m²，名義承壓0.5/0.1=5 MPa，未檢查管片彎裂。 接縫不平或墊片缺損會使少數管片先受力，局部崩角與裂縫可能在總推力正常時出現；錯把環平均承壓當局部容許值會漏掉脆弱細部。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「襯砌反力與局部承壓」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When reaction shifts from rock walls to completed segments, the load path moves through thrust shoes, segment joints and ring interfaces. Equal allocation is only an accounting model; eccentricity and gaps can create much higher local bearing under individual shoes. Assume 12 MN shared equally by 24 shoes: each carries 0.5 MN. With effective area 0.1 m² per shoe, nominal bearing is 0.5/0.1=5 MPa. Segment bending and cracking are not checked. Uneven joints or damaged packing can engage only a few segments initially. Corner spalling or cracks may appear at a normal total thrust. Treating ring-average bearing as a local allowable stress misses vulnerable details. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Lining reaction and local bearing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.check: 系統圖標明「襯砌反力與局部承壓」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Lining reaction and local bearing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 襯砌反力與局部承壓
knowledge.text: 當岩壁反力不足而改由已完成管片承受推力時，力流轉向推靴接觸、管片接縫及環間傳遞。平均分配僅供列帳，實際偏心和缺口會造成個別推靴較大的局部承壓。
knowledge.textEn: When reaction shifts from rock walls to completed segments, the load path moves through thrust shoes, segment joints and ring interfaces. Equal allocation is only an accounting model; eccentricity and gaps can create much higher local bearing under individual shoes.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要總推力相同，岩壁與管片反力模式等效。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Rock reaction and segment reaction are equivalent whenever total thrust is unchanged. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「襯砌反力與局部承壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Lining reaction and local bearing" is correct?
options: 只要總推力相同，岩壁與管片反力模式等效。
當岩壁反力不足而改由已完成管片承受推力時，力流轉向推靴接觸、管片接縫及環間傳遞。
兩項工序並行後，循環時間等於兩者時間平均。
optionsEn: Rock reaction and segment reaction are equivalent whenever total thrust is unchanged.
When reaction shifts from rock walls to completed segments, the load path moves through thrust shoes, segment joints and ring interfaces.
Once two tasks run concurrently, cycle time equals the average of their durations.
quiz.explanation: 當岩壁反力不足而改由已完成管片承受推力時，力流轉向推靴接觸、管片接縫及環間傳遞。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: When reaction shifts from rock walls to completed segments, the load path moves through thrust shoes, segment joints and ring interfaces. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 襯砌反力與局部承壓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lining reaction and local bearing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「襯砌反力與局部承壓」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lining reaction and local bearing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設總推力12 MN由24個推靴平均承擔，各為0.5 MN；每個有效面積0.1 m²，名義承壓0.5/0.1=5 MPa，未檢查管片彎裂。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume 12 MN shared equally by 24 shoes: each carries 0.5 MN. With effective area 0.1 m² per shoe, nominal bearing is 0.5/0.1=5 MPa. Segment bending and cracking are not checked. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對各缸壓力、推靴面積、環號及接縫高差，將最大單靴力和平均力分別繪圖；以裂縫與接觸痕跡記錄驗證均分假設，任何局部損傷須與管片設計者核對而非以平均數消除。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check individual ram pressures, shoe areas, ring IDs and joint offsets.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設總推力12 MN由24個推靴平均承擔，各為0.5 MN；每個有效面積0.1 m²，名義承壓0.5/0.1=5 MPa，未檢查管片彎裂。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume 12 MN shared equally by 24 shoes: each carries 0.5 MN. With effective area 0.1 m² per shoe, nominal bearing is 0.5/0.1=5 MPa. Segment bending and cracking are not checked.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「襯砌反力與局部承壓」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Lining reaction and local bearing", which statement holds?
options: 左右行程差除以基距所得角度就是核准導向量。
只要利用率相同，不同時間邊界的數據就可直接比較。
教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: Differential travel divided by baseline directly gives the approved steering adjustment.
Equal utilization percentages are directly comparable even when their time boundaries differ.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 襯砌反力與局部承壓：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lining reaction and local bearing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「襯砌反力與局部承壓」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lining reaction and local bearing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對各缸壓力、推靴面積、環號及接縫高差，將最大單靴力和平均力分別繪圖；以裂縫與接觸痕跡記錄驗證均分假設，任何局部損傷須與管片設計者核對而非以平均數消除。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check individual ram pressures, shoe areas, ring IDs and joint offsets. Plot maximum shoe force separately from the mean. Crack and contact-mark records test the equal-share assumption; localized damage must be referred to the segment designer rather than averaged away. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：模式切換交接表需列出新的受力構件、有效接觸與核准檢查；管片工程師確認受力條件，設備主管再依正式程序決定可否切換。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: A mode-change handover lists the newly loaded components, effective contacts and approved checks. The segment engineer confirms the structural conditions before the equipment lead determines whether a change is permissible under the formal procedure.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：接縫不平或墊片缺損會使少數管片先受力，局部崩角與裂縫可能在總推力正常時出現；錯把環平均承壓當局部容許值會漏掉脆弱細部。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Uneven joints or damaged packing can engage only a few segments initially. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對各缸壓力、推靴面積、環號及接縫高差，將最大單靴力和平均力分別繪圖；以裂縫與接觸痕跡記錄驗證均分假設，任何局部損傷須與管片設計者核對而非以平均數消除。
knowledge.textEn: Check individual ram pressures, shoe areas, ring IDs and joint offsets. Plot maximum shoe force separately from the mean. Crack and contact-mark records test the equal-share assumption; localized damage must be referred to the segment designer rather than averaged away.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 模式切換交接表需列出新的受力構件、有效接觸與核准檢查；管片工程師確認受力條件，設備主管再依正式程序決定可否切換。
knowledge.textEn: A mode-change handover lists the newly loaded components, effective contacts and approved checks. The segment engineer confirms the structural conditions before the equipment lead determines whether a change is permissible under the formal procedure.

quiz.question: 要驗證「襯砌反力與局部承壓」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Lining reaction and local bearing"?
options: 核對各缸壓力、推靴面積、環號及接縫高差，將最大單靴力和平均力分別繪圖；以裂縫與接觸痕跡記錄驗證均分假設，任何局部損傷須與管片設計者核對而非以平均數消除。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
伸縮行程夠長便能無限並行掘進與拼裝。
optionsEn: Check individual ram pressures, shoe areas, ring IDs and joint offsets.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Long telescopic travel allows excavation and assembly to continue concurrently without interruption.
quiz.explanation: 核對各缸壓力、推靴面積、環號及接縫高差，將最大單靴力和平均力分別繪圖；以裂縫與接觸痕跡記錄驗證均分假設，任何局部損傷須與管片設計者核對而非以平均數消除。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check individual ram pressures, shoe areas, ring IDs and joint offsets. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 襯砌反力與局部承壓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lining reaction and local bearing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「襯砌反力與局部承壓」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lining reaction and local bearing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 接縫不平或墊片缺損會使少數管片先受力，局部崩角與裂縫可能在總推力正常時出現；錯把環平均承壓當局部容許值會漏掉脆弱細部。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Uneven joints or damaged packing can engage only a few segments initially. Corner spalling or cracks may appear at a normal total thrust. Treating ring-average bearing as a local allowable stress misses vulnerable details. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：接縫不平或墊片缺損會使少數管片先受力，局部崩角與裂縫可能在總推力正常時出現；錯把環平均承壓當局部容許值會漏掉脆弱細部。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Treating ring-average bearing as a local allowable stress misses vulnerable details.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要總推力相同，岩壁與管片反力模式等效。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Rock reaction and segment reaction are equivalent whenever total thrust is unchanged." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 接縫不平或墊片缺損會使少數管片先受力，局部崩角與裂縫可能在總推力正常時出現；錯把環平均承壓當局部容許值會漏掉脆弱細部。
knowledge.textEn: Uneven joints or damaged packing can engage only a few segments initially. Corner spalling or cracks may appear at a normal total thrust. Treating ring-average bearing as a local allowable stress misses vulnerable details.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「襯砌反力與局部承壓」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Lining reaction and local bearing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
接縫不平或墊片缺損會使少數管片先受力，局部崩角與裂縫可能在總推力正常時出現；錯把環平均承壓當局部容許值會漏掉脆弱細部。
兩項工序並行後，循環時間等於兩者時間平均。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Uneven joints or damaged packing can engage only a few segments initially.
Once two tasks run concurrently, cycle time equals the average of their durations.
quiz.explanation: 接縫不平或墊片缺損會使少數管片先受力，局部崩角與裂縫可能在總推力正常時出現；錯把環平均承壓當局部容許值會漏掉脆弱細部。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Uneven joints or damaged packing can engage only a few segments initially. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「並行工序與關鍵循環」與「盾殼接觸與擠壓阻力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Parallel tasks and critical cycle" and "Shield contact and squeezing resistance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 並行工序與關鍵循環：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Parallel tasks and critical cycle: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「並行工序與關鍵循環」如何影響雙護盾硬岩潛盾施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Parallel tasks and critical cycle” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Double-shield hard-rock TBM operation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 能同時進行的切削與組環，循環時間受較慢工序控制，而非兩者相加；重新定位等不可重疊工作仍必須另計。後勤供應若不能配合，並行機構本身不會創造有效進尺。 假設切削30 min、組環25 min、定位5 min，每環並行循環max(30,25)+5=35 min；順序循環為60 min，理想時間節省25/60=41.7%。 若把定位時間藏在兩個工序內又相加，會高估等待；反之忽略等料會高估產能。兩種錯帳都使瓶頸判讀偏離實際，設備改善可能被投入錯誤環節。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「並行工序與關鍵循環」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: For truly overlapping cutting and ring assembly, the slower activity governs elapsed time rather than their sum. Non-overlapping tasks such as regripping remain additional. Concurrent mechanics cannot produce useful advance when supply logistics fail to match the required rhythm. Assume cutting 30 min, assembly 25 min and regripping 5 min. A parallel cycle is max(30,25)+5=35 min versus 60 min sequentially; ideal time saving is 25/60=41.7%. Hiding regripping inside two activities and then adding both overstates delay, while omitting supply waits overstates output. Either bookkeeping error misidentifies the bottleneck and can direct improvements toward the wrong subsystem. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Parallel tasks and critical cycle” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩項工序並行後，循環時間等於兩者時間平均。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once two tasks run concurrently, cycle time equals the average of their durations." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「並行工序與關鍵循環」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Parallel tasks and critical cycle”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 並行工序與關鍵循環
knowledge.text: 能同時進行的切削與組環，循環時間受較慢工序控制，而非兩者相加；重新定位等不可重疊工作仍必須另計。後勤供應若不能配合，並行機構本身不會創造有效進尺。
knowledge.textEn: For truly overlapping cutting and ring assembly, the slower activity governs elapsed time rather than their sum. Non-overlapping tasks such as regripping remain additional.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩項工序並行後，循環時間等於兩者時間平均。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once two tasks run concurrently, cycle time equals the average of their durations. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「並行工序與關鍵循環」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Parallel tasks and critical cycle" is correct?
options: 兩項工序並行後，循環時間等於兩者時間平均。
停機沒有切削，岩體與盾殼接觸狀態便不變。
能同時進行的切削與組環，循環時間受較慢工序控制，而非兩者相加；重新定位等不可重疊工作仍必須另計。
optionsEn: Once two tasks run concurrently, cycle time equals the average of their durations.
Without cutting during a shutdown, ground contact with the shield remains unchanged.
For truly overlapping cutting and ring assembly, the slower activity governs elapsed time rather than their sum.
quiz.explanation: 能同時進行的切削與組環，循環時間受較慢工序控制，而非兩者相加；重新定位等不可重疊工作仍必須另計。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: For truly overlapping cutting and ring assembly, the slower activity governs elapsed time rather than their sum. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 並行工序與關鍵循環：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Parallel tasks and critical cycle: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「並行工序與關鍵循環」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Parallel tasks and critical cycle” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設切削30 min、組環25 min、定位5 min，每環並行循環max(30,25)+5=35 min；順序循環為60 min，理想時間節省25/60=41.7%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume cutting 30 min, assembly 25 min and regripping 5 min. A parallel cycle is max(30,25)+5=35 min versus 60 min sequentially; ideal time saving is 25/60=41.7%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用共同時鐘標註切削、組環、定位、等料和故障事件，抽查同時作業是否真的重疊；將理想循環與完整班次分開比較，統計缺漏不能自動歸入掘進時間，班次主管須簽認事件分類。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Time-stamp cutting, assembly, regripping, waiting and faults using one clock.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：兩種錯帳都使瓶頸判讀偏離實際，設備改善可能被投入錯誤環節。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 盾殼接觸與擠壓阻力：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「盾殼接觸與擠壓阻力」如何影響雙護盾硬岩潛盾施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。

steps.instructionEn: Squeezing ground can establish contact over a long shield length. Resistance depends on pressure, contact length and friction. Uniform circumferential pressure demonstrates scaling, but real contact patches and their evolution with time require separate analysis. Assume D=6 m, contact length L=4 m, p=0.2 MPa and μ=0.3. Uniform-contact friction is F=μpπDL=4.52 MN; at L=6 m it becomes 6.79 MN. Convergence may continue during downtime, increasing restart demand while travel decreases. Attributing all additional resistance to cutter wear can miss time-dependent shield contact and the associated risk of the shield becoming trapped. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Shield contact and squeezing resistance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 姿態差與推力偏心：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「姿態差與推力偏心」如何影響雙護盾硬岩潛盾施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Attitude difference and thrust eccentricity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Double-shield hard-rock TBM operation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 左右推進不均可形成轉動和偏心反力，但小角度幾何只能描述位移差，不證明周圍岩體允許該姿態。導向評估還要連接盾殼淨空、線形曲率以及後方環體位置。 假設左右量測基距B=5 m、行程差Δ=10 mm=0.010 m，小角θ≈Δ/B=0.002 rad=0.115°；並非允許導向角。 單側行程感測漂移可能被誤判為機體偏航，導致不必要的受力調整；相反，真實偏心若被當作校正問題，管片與盾殼局部接觸會持續累積。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「姿態差與推力偏心」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Unequal advance can cause rotation and eccentric reaction. Small-angle geometry describes differential movement but does not show that the ground permits the attitude. Steering interpretation must also consider shield clearance, alignment curvature and the positions of completed rings. Assume lateral baseline B=5 m and differential travel Δ=10 mm=0.010 m. The small angle is θ≈Δ/B=0.002 rad=0.115°, not an allowable steering angle. A drifting travel sensor may be mistaken for yaw and prompt unnecessary load changes. Conversely, treating genuine eccentricity as calibration error allows concentrated contact on the shield and segments to persist. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Attitude difference and thrust eccentricity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 機械能與開挖體積的比值可用於比較同一設備在不同環段的表現，但它同時受刀具、岩性、轉速與停機分類影響。比能升高不是岩石強度增加的唯一證據，輸入功率也不等於純破岩功率。 假設平均機械功率800 kW、有效切削0.5 h、開挖40 m³，E/V=800×0.5/40=10 kWh/m³=36 MJ/m³，未扣除各項損失。 把整班用電除以少量進尺會製造虛高比能，掩蓋真正的後勤停頓；若據此推定岩體更硬，磨耗或待機問題便可能被錯誤歸因。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「切削能量與岩況判讀」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Inferring harder ground from that number can misclassify wear or standby losses as a geological change. steps.instruction: 把整班用電除以少量進尺會製造虛高比能，掩蓋真正的後勤停頓；若據此推定岩體更硬，磨耗或待機問題便可能被錯誤歸因。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 停機利用率與敏感度：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「停機利用率與敏感度」如何影響雙護盾硬岩潛盾施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Downtime utilization and sensitivity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Double-shield hard-rock TBM operation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 日進尺等於有效切削速度乘切削時間，不應在已扣停機的時間上再次乘利用率。分開排程時數與有效切削時數，才能比較維修和供料改善的實際作用，也避免重複扣除同一損失。 假設貫入5 mm/rev、2 rev/min、排程20 h/day、利用率0.5，進尺=5×2×60×20×0.5/1000=6 m/day；利用率0.4時為4.8 m/day。 把有效切削十小時再乘一半利用率會低估進尺，反之將轉動但無進尺列為切削會高估效率；這些定義錯誤會誤導維修投資及工期溝通。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「停機利用率與敏感度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Daily advance equals active cutting rate multiplied by actual cutting time. Utilization must not be applied again to hours already excluding downtime. Separating scheduled hours from active hours allows meaningful maintenance and supply comparisons without counting the same loss twice. Assume penetration 5 mm/rev, 2 rev/min, schedule 20 h/day and utilization 0.5. Advance is 5×2×60×20×0.5/1000=6 m/day; utilization 0.4 gives 4.8 m/day. Multiplying ten already-active hours by one-half utilization understates advance. Counting rotation without progress as useful cutting overstates efficiency. These definition errors can misdirect maintenance investment and communication about schedule expectations. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Downtime utilization and sensitivity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume penetration 5 mm/rev, 2 rev/min, schedule 20 h/day and utilization 0.5. Advance is 5×2×60×20×0.5/1000=6 m/day; utilization 0.4 gives 4.8 m/day. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以刀盤實際運轉且有有效前進的事件定義切削時間，交叉核對班報與控制系統；分類停機原因並檢查總時數是否等於排程時數，任何重疊分類必須在比較利用率前先釐清。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
